intro.prompt: Professional document analysis, AI technology, modern office

scenes.voiceover: Introducing Paper Perfector. Intelligent document creation powered by advanced AI.
Open the assistant to explore your starting options.
Start with a blank document to build your narrative from scratch.
The workspace loads your new document in structured edit mode.
Toggle edit mode to refine your content directly.
Scroll through the structured sections to review the layout.
Open format settings to adjust fonts, margins, and spacing.
Save your work to the library for future access.
Export to PDF when you are ready to share or print.
Paper Perfector. Transform how you work with documents. Enterprise-grade intelligence at your fingertips.
